title: Person: Stephen
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Stephen

anchor.prefix:
sat and said:

 —Now then, sir, there’s a bird here waiting for you.

 When all had taken their seats he laid his hand on the cover and then said quickly, withdrawing it:

 —Now,
anchor.suffix:
.

 Stephen stood up in his place to say the grace before meals:

 Bless us, O Lord, and these Thy gifts which through Thy bounty we are about to receive through Christ our Lord. A
